title: Longest Substring Containing Vowels in Even Counts
description: Given a lowercase string `s`, return the length of the longest contiguous substring in which each of the five vowels `'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, and `'u'` appears an even number of times (zero is even).
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters.
hints: Encode the parity (even/odd) of the 5 vowel counts as a 5-bit integer mask (0..31).
A substring s[l..r] has all even vowel counts iff prefixMask[r + 1] == prefixMask[l]. Store the earliest index seen for each of the 32 masks.

examples.explanation: "leetminicowor" has length 13 and contains 2 'e's, 2 'i's, and 2 'o's (with 0 'a' and 0 'u').
"leetc" has length 5 and contains 2 'e's and 0 of the other vowels.
No vowels appear in "bcbcbc", so the entire string of length 6 is valid.
